leftEvidence.title: Moses enters the cloud after six days

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Moses goes up Sinai with Joshua, the cloud covers the mountain for six days, and the LORD calls from the cloud on the seventh day.
points.right: After six days Jesus takes three disciples up a high mountain; his face shines, his clothes become white, and Moses and Elijah appear speaking with him.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: The visible glory appears like consuming fire while Moses remains on the mountain forty days and nights.
points.right: Peter proposes three tents; a bright cloud overshadows them, the voice names the beloved Son and commands listening, and the frightened disciples finally see Jesus alone.

payload.posture: Both scenes join mountain ascent, selected companions, six days, cloud, glory, and divine speech.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John

payload.tension: Moses enters Sinai’s cloud; Matthew places Moses beside the transfigured Jesus inside another event.
payload.title: Sinai cloud and the bright cloud
